id: 01_Safety Officer Interview Questions and Answers HSE Officer Interview Questions
title: 安全知识问答：从基本概念到现场设备（国内版）
source_doc: course/ACS Hazard Communication & Safety/01_Safety Officer Interview Questions and Answers HSE Officer Interview Questions.md
author_source: project/ACS Hazard Communication & Safety/01_Safety Officer Interview Questions and Answers HSE Officer Interview Questions（国内版）/src.py

points.K35: 脚手架的防护措施（了解）
points.K37: 脚手架的基本要求（了解）
points.S1: 安全责任：学校、学院、实验室
points.S2: 隐患和未遂事件要报告
points.S3: 读懂安全技术说明书和标签

shots.scene: 欣欣站在问答台后，身边亮着一个问号灯
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands behind a quiz podium with a glowing question mark lamp beside it and waves at the camera.
shots.narration: 欢迎来到安全知识问答！
overlay: 安全知识问答：从基本概念到现场设备

shots.scene: 四个图标排成一行：问号、盾牌、烧瓶、安全帽
shots.prompt_en: Four icons in a row: a question mark, a shield, a laboratory flask and a hard hat. No people.
shots.narration: 从基本概念讲起，一直讲到现场设备。

shots.scene: 阿杰拿着空白卡片挠头，小研在一旁看
shots.prompt_en: The young male student holds a stack of blank cards and scratches his head; the female graduate student looks on.
shots.narration: 阿杰要参加实验室安全考核，概念全混了。

shots.scene: 空白卡片上分别画着三角警示、红十字、碰撞图标，乱成一团
shots.prompt_en: Blank cards scattered on a desk showing a warning triangle icon, a red cross icon and a collision icon, all mixed up. No people.
shots.narration: 危害、风险、事故，到底有啥区别？

shots.scene: 欣欣从问答台后探出身，举起问号牌
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot leans out from behind the quiz podium and holds up a blank card with a question mark icon.
shots.narration: 别急，我们一题一题来。

shots.scene: 欣欣站在整洁的实验室中央，身旁浮现人、仪器、地球三个图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands in a tidy laboratory with three floating icons beside it: a person, an instrument and a globe.
shots.narration: 第一题：什么是安全？

shots.scene: 人、财产、环境三个图标外罩一层盾牌
shots.prompt_en: A person icon, a building icon and a tree icon under one protective shield. No people.
shots.narration: 人不受伤，财物不受损，环境不受害。

shots.scene: 小研在整洁的实验台前点头
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student nods beside a tidy, well-organized lab bench.
shots.narration: 远离这些伤害的状态，就是安全。

shots.scene: 欣欣指向地上一条横着的电线和桌角突出的玻璃板
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot points at a cable lying across the lab floor and a glass plate sticking out over a bench edge.
shots.narration: 危害，是一切可能造成伤害的东西。

shots.scene: 杂乱的过道和锋利边角两个图标，各带黄色警示三角
shots.prompt_en: Two icons each with a yellow warning triangle: a cluttered walkway with boxes and a sharp broken glass edge. No people.
shots.narration: 比如过道杂乱、碎玻璃的锋利边缘。

shots.scene: 手指贴着创可贴的图标和夹板固定的手臂图标
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a finger with a bandage and an icon of an arm in a splint. No people.
shots.narration: 伤害，是事故落在身上的后果。

shots.scene: 阿杰看着自己贴了创可贴的手指
shots.prompt_en: The young male student looks at a small bandage on his finger in the lab.
shots.narration: 比如割伤、骨折。

shots.scene: 打翻的试剂瓶、冒烟的仪器、倒下的人三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons: a tipped-over reagent bottle, a smoking instrument and a fallen person pictogram. No people.
shots.narration: 事故，是没有计划、造成损失的意外。

shots.scene: 财产、环境、人身三个图标上都打了红色感叹号
shots.prompt_en: A building icon, a tree icon and a person icon, each with a red exclamation mark. No people.
shots.narration: 可能损坏财物、污染环境，甚至致命。

shots.scene: 架子上一只烧杯滑落，落在阿杰脚边半米处摔碎
shots.prompt_en: A beaker slides off a high shelf and shatters on the floor half a meter from the young male student's feet; he jumps back.
shots.narration: 未遂事件：差一点就伤到人。

shots.scene: 掉落的锤子图标，旁边的小人图标完好
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a falling hammer landing next to a person pictogram that is unharmed. No people.
shots.narration: 没伤到人，但它有造成伤害的可能。

shots.scene: 欣欣竖起食指，神情认真
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot raises one finger with a serious face.
shots.narration: 未遂事件是提醒，不能当没发生。

shots.scene: 欣欣举着天平，一端是骰子图标，一端是爆炸图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds a balance scale with a dice icon on one side and a small burst icon on the other.
shots.narration: 风险，是被危害伤到的可能性。

shots.scene: 可能性乘后果的示意：骰子图标、乘号、伤害图标
shots.prompt_en: A simple equation made of icons: a dice icon, a multiplication sign, an injury icon, an equals sign and a gauge icon. No people.
shots.narration: 也常写成：可能性乘以后果。

shots.scene: 小研在空白风险矩阵板上贴标记
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student places a marker on a blank grid board with green, yellow and red squares.
shots.narration: 可能性越大、后果越重，风险越高。

shots.scene: 五个圆形图标围成一圈：书、奖章、齿轮、法槌、放大镜
shots.prompt_en: Five round icons in a circle: a book, a medal, a gear, a gavel and a magnifying glass. No people.
shots.narration: 预防事故，有五个E。

shots.scene: 王老师给学生上培训课
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator teaches a group of students in a training room in front of a blank screen.
shots.narration: 教育靠培训，激励靠表扬和奖励。

shots.scene: 老李在通风柜旁调试，旁边是规章文件夹
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer adjusts a fume hood next to a shelf with blank rule binders.
shots.narration: 工程措施加上严格执行制度。

shots.scene: 放大镜图标扫过一张打勾的清单
shots.prompt_en: A magnifying glass icon moves over a blank checklist with green check marks. No people.
shots.narration: 最后还要评估效果，持续改进。

shots.scene: 倒金字塔分五层，从上到下颜色由绿到红
shots.prompt_en: An inverted pyramid divided into five colored layers from green at the top to red at the bottom. No people.
shots.narration: 控制危害，有一个层级顺序。

shots.scene: 危险试剂瓶图标被划掉，换成低毒试剂瓶图标
shots.prompt_en: A reagent bottle with a skull pictogram is crossed out and replaced by a bottle with a milder warning pictogram. No people.
shots.narration: 先想能否消除，或换成低危害的。

shots.scene: 小研在通风柜里操作，旁边有空白规程卡
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student works inside a fume hood, a blank procedure card pinned beside it.
shots.narration: 再用通风柜等工程控制和管理制度。

shots.scene: 护目镜、手套、实验服图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of safety goggles, gloves and a lab coat. No people.
shots.narration: 个人防护是最后一道防线。

shots.scene: 杂乱的实验台变得整洁的前后对比
shots.prompt_en: A before-and-after view: a messy lab bench on the left and the same bench neat and organized on the right. No people.
shots.narration: 5S，让工作场所整洁有序。

shots.scene: 阿杰把破损的烧杯和不用的工具放进回收箱
shots.prompt_en: The young male student puts a cracked beaker and unused tools into a collection box.
shots.narration: 整理：清走坏的、不用的东西。

shots.scene: 小研把试剂瓶按标记位置摆放，然后擦桌面
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student places bottles back in marked positions on a shelf and then wipes the bench.
shots.narration: 整顿归位，清扫干净。

shots.scene: 墙上贴着空白检查表，打满绿勾
shots.prompt_en: A blank checklist on the lab wall filled with green check marks. No people.
shots.narration: 定好标准，天天坚持。

shots.scene: 老周在空白承诺书上签字
shots.prompt_en: The older man signs a blank commitment document at his desk.
shots.narration: 安全方针，是最高管理者的书面承诺。

shots.scene: 承诺书图标上方是心形和盾牌
shots.prompt_en: A blank document icon with a heart icon and a shield icon above it. No people.
shots.narration: 承诺照顾好每个人的健康和安全。

shots.scene: 三张空白卡片依次亮起：靶心、人像、齿轮
shots.prompt_en: Three blank cards light up one by one: a target icon, a person icon and a gear icon. No people.
shots.narration: 要写清：做什么、谁来做、怎么做。

shots.scene: 空白计划书从承诺书图标中延伸出来
shots.prompt_en: A blank plan booklet extends from a commitment document icon with an arrow. No people.
shots.narration: 安全计划，是把承诺落地的方案。

shots.scene: 小研在每项实验任务卡旁贴上危害标记和对策卡
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student pins hazard markers and blank control cards next to each task card on a board.
shots.narration: 逐项找出危害和风险，配上控制措施。

shots.scene: 欣欣捧着一本空白操作规程手册
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds up a blank procedure manual with numbered step icons.
shots.narration: 标准操作规程，就是书面的操作步骤。

shots.scene: 规程手册上步骤一二三的图标，旁边是危险作业图标
shots.prompt_en: A manual open to step icons one, two and three, next to an icon of a hazardous task with a warning triangle. No people.
shots.narration: 详细写明危险工作怎样安全地做。

shots.scene: 阿杰照着贴在仪器旁的规程卡逐步操作
shots.prompt_en: The young male student follows a blank step card posted next to an instrument, checking each step.
shots.narration: 不同工作有不同规程，照着做。

shots.scene: 五级台阶图标，每级一个图标
shots.prompt_en: Five stairs, each with an icon: a magnifying glass, a group of people, a scale, a notepad and a circular arrow. No people.
shots.narration: 风险评估，分五步。

shots.scene: 小研和阿杰在实验前围着空白评估表讨论
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student and the young male student discuss a blank assessment form at a bench before an experiment.
shots.narration: 先找危害，想清楚谁会受伤、怎么伤。

shots.scene: 表格上逐行打勾，配控制措施图标
shots.prompt_en: A blank form with rows getting check marks, and control icons appearing beside them. No people.
shots.narration: 评估风险，定好措施，并记录下来。

shots.scene: 日历图标和循环箭头
shots.prompt_en: A calendar icon with a circular arrow around it. No people.
shots.narration: 条件变了或定期，都要回顾更新。

shots.scene: 放大镜对准一张事故示意图
shots.prompt_en: A magnifying glass over a simple diagram of a spilled bottle and a slipping person pictogram. No people.
shots.narration: 调查事故，不是为了找人出气。

shots.scene: 树根图标、扳手图标、法规书图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons: tree roots, a wrench and a law book. No people.
shots.narration: 查根本原因，定纠正措施，满足法规。

shots.scene: 老周和王老师一起看空白调查报告
shots.prompt_en: The older man and the safety administrator review a blank investigation report together.
shots.narration: 目的就是：同样的事不再发生。

shots.scene: 柱状图图标旁有时钟和小人图标
shots.prompt_en: A bar chart icon next to a clock icon and a group of person pictograms. No people.
shots.narration: 企业常算事故频率：按工时折算。

shots.scene: 分数线图标：上面是事故图标，下面是时钟图标
shots.prompt_en: A fraction made of icons: an accident icon above the line and a clock icon below the line. No people.
shots.narration: 损失工时事故数，除以总工时再放大。

shots.scene: 分数线图标：上面是日历图标，下面是时钟图标
shots.prompt_en: A fraction made of icons: a calendar icon with crossed days above the line and a clock icon below. No people.
shots.narration: 严重程度，看损失了多少工作日。

shots.scene: 欣欣看着两根高矮不同的柱子
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot looks at two bars of different heights on a blank chart.
shots.narration: 次数看频率，天数看严重程度。

shots.scene: 会议桌两边人数相等，中间是安全盾牌图标
shots.prompt_en: A meeting table with equal numbers of seats on each side and a shield icon in the middle; the older man and the female graduate student sit across from each other.
shots.narration: 安全委员会，管理层和员工代表一起开。

shots.scene: 王老师主持会议，大家在空白议程上讨论
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator leads a meeting; the older man, the female graduate student and the young male student discuss a blank agenda.
shots.narration: 专门讨论安全问题，共同想办法。

shots.scene: 左边望远镜图标，右边后视镜图标
shots.prompt_en: A telescope icon on the left and a rear-view mirror icon on the right. No people.
shots.narration: 安全指标，分先行和滞后两类。

shots.scene: 培训图标和检查清单图标，上面有向上箭头
shots.prompt_en: A training class icon and a checklist icon with an upward arrow. No people.
shots.narration: 先行指标：培训几次、检查几次。

shots.scene: 事故图标和病假图标，上面有向下箭头
shots.prompt_en: An accident icon and a sick-leave bed icon with a downward arrow. No people.
shots.narration: 滞后指标：事故率、伤病缺勤。

shots.scene: 欣欣指向望远镜图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot points at the telescope icon.
shots.narration: 多盯先行指标，才能防患于未然。

shots.scene: 空气中漂浮的小分子点，旁边一个小人图标和日历
shots.prompt_en: Small floating molecule dots in the air next to a person pictogram and a calendar icon. No people.
shots.narration: 接触限值，说的是空气中有害物浓度。

shots.scene: 小人图标在一条长时间线上走过
shots.prompt_en: A person pictogram walking along a long timeline from young to old, with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 阈限值：天天接触、干一辈子也不伤身。

shots.scene: 王老师指着空白标准文本
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator points at a blank standard document.
shots.narration: 国内按职业接触限值标准执行。

shots.scene: 时钟图标显示八小时，日历显示一周五天
shots.prompt_en: A clock icon showing a full working day and a calendar icon with five weekdays highlighted. No people.
shots.narration: 时间加权平均：按每天八小时平均。

shots.scene: 波动的浓度曲线，下面一条平均线
shots.prompt_en: A wavy concentration line with a flat average line drawn under it. No people.
shots.narration: 长期接触，平均浓度不能超限。

shots.scene: 沙漏图标旁一个浓度尖峰
shots.prompt_en: An hourglass icon next to a short sharp peak on a concentration line. No people.
shots.narration: 短时间接触：一刻钟内的接触上限。

shots.scene: 尖峰被一条红线压住
shots.prompt_en: The short peak is capped by a red limit line. No people.
shots.narration: 短时间里，浓度也不能冲高。

shots.scene: 最高浓度线图标
shots.prompt_en: A concentration line with a solid red ceiling line that it never touches. No people.
shots.narration: 有些物质规定了任何时候都不能超的值。

shots.scene: 红色警示区里的骷髅图标，小人图标退出
shots.prompt_en: A red danger zone with a skull pictogram and a person pictogram stepping back out of it. No people.
shots.narration: 还有一种浓度，一接触就危及生命。

shots.scene: 门上挂着禁止进入标志，旁边有气体检测仪图标
shots.prompt_en: A door with a no entry sign and a gas detector icon beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 这种环境，未经检测和防护绝不进入。

shots.scene: 欣欣摇头，旁边数字被问号盖住
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot shakes its head beside a blank card covered by a large question mark.
shots.narration: 具体数值查说明书和标准，别凭记忆。

shots.scene: 液体表面冒出蒸气，靠近火花时一闪
shots.prompt_en: Vapor rises from the surface of a liquid in an open dish; a spark nearby makes a brief flash. No people.
shots.narration: 闪点：液体蒸气遇火能闪燃的最低温度。

shots.scene: 温度计图标，指针位置较低
shots.prompt_en: A thermometer icon with a low reading next to a flammable liquid pictogram. No people.
shots.narration: 闪点越低，越容易着火。

shots.scene: 闪一下的火焰变成持续燃烧的火焰
shots.prompt_en: A brief flash above a liquid turns into a steady flame that keeps burning. No people.
shots.narration: 燃点：点着以后能持续燃烧的最低温度。

shots.scene: 两个温度计，燃点比闪点略高
shots.prompt_en: Two thermometer icons side by side, the second slightly higher than the first. No people.
shots.narration: 燃点一般比闪点高一些。

shots.scene: 热板上的容器自己冒出火苗，周围没有火源
shots.prompt_en: A closed container on a very hot plate bursts into flame by itself with no spark or flame nearby. No people.
shots.narration: 自燃点：没有火源，自己就着了。

shots.scene: 热表面图标靠近易燃液体图标，被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a hot surface next to a flammable liquid bottle, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 易燃物远离高温表面。

shots.scene: 建筑外的红色消火栓，接着一条消防水带
shots.prompt_en: A red outdoor fire hydrant next to a building with a rolled fire hose connected. No people.
shots.narration: 消火栓，是消防员接水带取水的接口。

shots.scene: 走廊里的消火栓箱，前面空空荡荡
shots.prompt_en: An indoor fire hose cabinet in a lab corridor with a clear empty space in front of it. No people.
shots.narration: 楼里的消火栓箱，前面不能堆东西。

shots.scene: 两个消火栓剖面图标：一个充满蓝色水，一个是空的
shots.prompt_en: Two simple cutaway icons of hydrants: one barrel filled with blue water under a sun icon, one empty barrel under a snowflake icon. No people.
shots.narration: 湿式栓体里有水，干式没水防冻。

shots.scene: 带阀门手轮的消火栓和没有手轮的消火栓
shots.prompt_en: Two hydrant icons: one with a valve wheel and one without a valve wheel. No people.
shots.narration: 有的能用阀门控制出水，有的不能。

shots.scene: 两个出水口和三个出水口的消火栓
shots.prompt_en: Two hydrant icons: one with two outlets and one with three outlets. No people.
shots.narration: 按出水口多少，分二通、三通。

shots.scene: 一排不同颜色的扁平吊带
shots.prompt_en: A row of flat lifting slings in different solid colors: violet, green, yellow, grey, red, brown, blue and orange. No people.
shots.narration: 起重吊带，用颜色区分额定载荷。

shots.scene: 每条吊带旁出现一个砝码图标，大小逐渐变大
shots.prompt_en: Each colored sling gets a weight icon beside it, the weights getting bigger along the row. No people.
shots.narration: 颜色不同，能吊的重量就不同。

shots.scene: 吊带上的空白标签被放大镜放大
shots.prompt_en: A magnifying glass enlarges a blank tag sewn onto a yellow sling. No people.
shots.narration: 看颜色，更要看吊带上的标签。

shots.scene: 吊带上的黑色条纹逐条亮起
shots.prompt_en: Black stripes woven along a sling light up one by one. No people.
shots.narration: 吊带上的条纹，也能看出载荷。

shots.scene: 标签缺失的吊带被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: A sling with a missing tag and a frayed edge, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 标签不清或磨损的吊带，不能用。

shots.scene: D形卸扣和弓形卸扣并排
shots.prompt_en: Two plain metal shackles side by side: a D-shaped shackle and a bow-shaped shackle. No people.
shots.narration: 卸扣常见两种：D形和弓形。

shots.scene: 卸扣线图，各部位依次高亮
shots.prompt_en: A simple line drawing of a bow shackle with its parts highlighted one by one: crown, bow, ears, pin and pin head. No people.
shots.narration: 卸扣由弓身、耳部、销轴等组成。

shots.scene: 放大镜照着卸扣表面空白的铭刻区
shots.prompt_en: A magnifying glass over the blank stamped marking area on a plain shackle. No people.
shots.narration: 卸扣上刻着载荷、尺寸、批号等标记。

shots.scene: 没有标记的卸扣被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: A shackle with no markings and a bent pin, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 看不清标记或变形的，不能用。

shots.scene: 老李和戴安全帽的工人图标，旁边是证书图标
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer stands next to a certificate icon and a crane hook icon.
shots.narration: 吊装作业，要由持证人员来做。

shots.scene: 建筑外搭着的脚手架，平台上放着工具箱
shots.prompt_en: A metal scaffold built against a building wall, with a toolbox on the platform. No people.
shots.narration: 脚手架，是高处作业的临时平台。

shots.scene: 平台上方有人、材料、工具三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Above the scaffold platform float three icons: a person, a stack of materials and a toolbox. No people.
shots.narration: 用来支撑人员、材料和工具。

shots.scene: 五个警示图标：人坠落、物坠落、架子倒塌、梯子缺失、电线
shots.prompt_en: Five warning icons in a row: a falling person, a falling object, a collapsing scaffold, a missing ladder and an overhead power line. No people.
shots.narration: 脚手架有五大危害。

shots.scene: 架子倒塌图标和架空电线图标加红色感叹号
shots.prompt_en: A collapsing scaffold icon and an overhead power line icon, each with a red exclamation mark. No people.
shots.narration: 人和物都可能坠落，架子会倒，还怕触电。

shots.section_title: 脚手架的防护措施（了解）
shots.scene: 全身式安全带、生命绳、锚点三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a full-body harness, a lifeline rope and an anchor point. No people.
shots.narration: 高处作业，系好全身式安全带。
overlay: 脚手架的防护措施（了解）

shots.section_title: 脚手架的防护措施（了解）
shots.scene: 带上横杆、中横杆、挡脚板的护栏示意
shots.prompt_en: A diagram of a scaffold guardrail with a top rail, a mid rail and a toe board, with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 护栏齐全，平台上不放散落物料。

shots.section_title: 脚手架的防护措施（了解）
shots.scene: 坚实地基上的脚手架和合格材料图标
shots.prompt_en: A scaffold standing on firm base plates with a green check next to a standard material icon. No people.
shots.narration: 材料合格，地基牢固。

shots.section_title: 脚手架的防护措施（了解）
shots.scene: 持证人员图标、梯子通道图标、远离电线箭头
shots.prompt_en: Three icons: a person with a certificate, a ladder access, and an arrow keeping distance from a power line. No people.
shots.narration: 专业人员搭设，通道合适，远离电线。

shots.scene: 剪叉式升降平台、吊椅、悬挂平台三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons: a scissor lift platform, a hanging seat on ropes and a suspended platform on two ropes. No people.
shots.narration: 脚手架种类很多，有升降的、悬挂的。

shots.scene: 梯架式和落地支撑式脚手架图标
shots.prompt_en: Two icons: a ladder jack scaffold and a ground-supported frame scaffold. No people.
shots.narration: 也有靠梯子架设和落地支撑的。

shots.section_title: 脚手架的基本要求（了解）
shots.scene: 高处平台边的护栏和安全带图标
shots.prompt_en: A high platform edge icon with a guardrail and a harness icon beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 高处作业，必须有护栏或防坠落系统。
overlay: 脚手架的基本要求（了解）

shots.section_title: 脚手架的基本要求（了解）
shots.scene: 脚手架上的大砝码图标，旁边是多倍号
shots.prompt_en: A large weight icon on a scaffold with a multiplier sign beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 架子要能承受数倍的设计荷载。

shots.section_title: 脚手架的基本要求（了解）
shots.scene: 王老师拿着空白规范文本
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator holds a blank standard booklet.
shots.narration: 具体要求按国内规范和单位规定。

shots.section_title: 安全责任：学校、学院、实验室
shots.scene: 三个相连的建筑图标：大学、学院、实验室
shots.prompt_en: Three linked building icons in a chain: a university building, a department building and a lab room. No people.
shots.narration: 在学校，安全有清晰的责任链条。
overlay: 安全责任：学校、学院、实验室

shots.section_title: 安全责任：学校、学院、实验室
shots.scene: 老周站在实验室门口，旁边有空白责任牌
shots.prompt_en: The older man stands at the laboratory door beside a blank responsibility sign.
shots.narration: 实验室负责人，是第一责任人。

shots.section_title: 安全责任：学校、学院、实验室
shots.scene: 小研和阿杰在空白承诺书上签名
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student and the young male student sign blank safety pledge forms.
shots.narration: 每个进实验室的人，都对安全有责任。

shots.section_title: 隐患和未遂事件要报告
shots.scene: 阿杰指着地上的水渍，小研拿起电话
shots.prompt_en: The young male student points at a puddle near an electrical socket; the female graduate student picks up a phone.
shots.narration: 发现隐患，马上报告，及时整改。
overlay: 隐患和未遂事件要报告

shots.section_title: 隐患和未遂事件要报告
shots.scene: 未遂事件图标进入一个空白记录本
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a near-miss falling beaker flies into a blank logbook. No people.
shots.narration: 未遂事件也要登记，分析原因。

shots.section_title: 隐患和未遂事件要报告
shots.scene: 被藏起来的警示三角被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a warning triangle being hidden under a box, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 不瞒报，下一次才不会真出事。

shots.section_title: 读懂安全技术说明书和标签
shots.scene: 小研翻看一份空白的化学品安全技术说明书
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student reads a blank chemical safety data sheet with section number icons.
shots.narration: 接触限值、闪点，都写在说明书里。
overlay: 读懂安全技术说明书和标签

shots.section_title: 读懂安全技术说明书和标签
shots.scene: 试剂瓶上的标签只有象形图
shots.prompt_en: A reagent bottle with a label showing only a flame pictogram and an exclamation mark pictogram, other text areas blank. No people.
shots.narration: 看懂标签上的象形图和警示词。

shots.section_title: 读懂安全技术说明书和标签
shots.scene: 阿杰在实验前对照说明书准备防护用品
shots.prompt_en: The young male student checks a blank data sheet and then picks up goggles and gloves.
shots.narration: 用新试剂前，先读说明书。

shots.scene: 小研在通风柜前，把移门拉到适当高度
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student lowers the fume hood sash to a safe working height before starting work.
shots.narration: 挥发性有害物，在通风柜里操作。

shots.scene: 通风柜里的容器放在靠里位置，气流箭头向内
shots.prompt_en: Inside a fume hood, containers sit well back from the front edge, with airflow arrows going inward. No people.
shots.narration: 物品放在柜内深处，移门别全开。

shots.scene: 通风柜里塞满瓶子，被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: A fume hood crammed full of bottles blocking the back vents, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 通风柜不是储物柜。

shots.scene: 老李在检查通风柜的风速指示
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer checks the airflow indicator on a fume hood.
shots.narration: 风量异常，停用并报修。

shots.scene: 阿杰踩在转椅上够高处的试剂，被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a student standing on a rolling chair to reach a high shelf, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 高处取物，别踩转椅和凳子。

shots.scene: 阿杰用稳固的登高梯取架上的空箱子，小研扶梯
shots.prompt_en: The young male student climbs a stable step ladder to reach a box on a high shelf while the female graduate student holds the ladder.
shots.narration: 用稳固的登高梯，有人扶梯。

shots.scene: 重瓶和液体放在下层架子上
shots.prompt_en: Heavy bottles and liquid containers stored on the lower shelves, light boxes on the top shelf. No people.
shots.narration: 重物、液体放低处，减少高处取放。

shots.scene: 欣欣举着电话图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds up a large telephone icon.
shots.narration: 万一出了事故，先保证人员安全。

shots.scene: 火焰图标旁写119，红十字图标旁写120
shots.prompt_en: A flame icon next to a telephone icon and a red cross icon next to another telephone icon. No people.
shots.narration: 火警拨打119，急救拨打120。

shots.scene: 报告链条图标：实验室负责人、学院、保卫处
shots.prompt_en: Three linked icons in a chain: a lab room, a department building and a security office badge. No people.
shots.narration: 同时报告负责人、学院和保卫处。

shots.scene: 保卫处值班员接听电话并记录
shots.prompt_en: The security officer answers a phone call and writes in a blank logbook.
shots.narration: 如实说明地点和情况，不迟报不瞒报。

shots.scene: 欣欣身旁浮现危害、风险、事故、未遂四个图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside four floating icons: a warning triangle, a gauge, a collision and a near-miss arrow.
shots.narration: 分清危害、风险、事故和未遂事件。

shots.scene: 倒金字塔和五级台阶图标
shots.prompt_en: An inverted pyramid icon and a five-step stair icon side by side. No people.
shots.narration: 按层级控制危害，按五步评估风险。

shots.scene: 规程手册、整洁实验台、通风柜图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a procedure manual, a tidy bench and a fume hood. No people.
shots.narration: 照规程做事，保持整洁，用好通风柜。

shots.scene: 温度计、气体分子、说明书图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a thermometer, floating gas molecules and a blank data sheet. No people.
shots.narration: 接触限值和闪点，查说明书和标准。

shots.scene: 安全带、吊带、消火栓图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a harness, a lifting sling and a fire hydrant. No people.
shots.narration: 现场设备作了解，专业作业要持证。

shots.scene: 电话图标和报告链条
shots.prompt_en: A telephone icon next to a chain of a lab, a department and a security badge. No people.
shots.narration: 隐患要报告，出事先报警。

shots.scene: 欣欣在问答台后鼓掌挥手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot claps and then waves goodbye from behind the quiz podium.
shots.narration: 答对安全题，更要做对安全事，再见！
